scope: HITL question history, mention rendering, group attribution and DM presentation
changes: Frontend presentation only; application reply authority, action binding and unknown-acknowledgment fences are retained.
iterations: Initial browser attempts included three selector failures: one assertion accidentally matched the sidebar waiting label and two expected an accessibility name without chip spacing. Selectors were scoped/updated, and the affected cases passed on rerun.
live_observations: Existing QA history and completed Computer activity verified after reload; one new real group ask_user interaction was selected, submitted and reloaded; existing DM history verified without side avatars.
live_retry: The new group prompt initially hit a routing failure. One UI retry succeeded. This does not prove failed assistant-response retry.
limits: No new active Computer stream or reconnect-fault exercise in this follow-up.
Pending approval and native acknowledgment/recovery behavior covered by controlled browser fixtures; existing real approval history inspected after reload.
No production deployment, commit, push, data reset, credential change or external message.

evidence.title: Avatar pada pesan grup
evidence.observation: Percakapan QA lama dibuka kembali. Avatar Tobi terlihat berdampingan dengan jawaban, termasuk jawaban pendek.

evidence.title: Pertanyaan lama dan mention setelah reload
evidence.observation: Pertanyaan yang sebelumnya telah dijawab kembali muncul sebagai kartu berisi judul saja. Mention owner terender sebagai Kamu; opsi dan tombol tidak muncul.

evidence.title: Riwayat approval setelah penolakan
evidence.observation: Approval yang telah ditolak tetap menyisakan judul pertanyaan. Rincian tindakan dan tombol keputusan tidak ditampilkan.

evidence.title: Avatar di samping kartu Computer
evidence.observation: Kartu Computer dari aktivitas nyata yang telah selesai memiliki avatar Tobi. Kartu tetap ringkas tanpa viewer atau Open Computer.

evidence.title: Pertanyaan baru: menunggu pilihan
evidence.observation: Prompt baru dijalankan melalui UI grup. Kartu options dengan mention owner tampil, tanpa bubble Waiting for your reply tambahan. Continue nonaktif sebelum ada pilihan.

evidence.title: Pertanyaan baru: pilihan terpilih
evidence.observation: Ringkas dipilih. Continue aktif dan kartu masih terbuka sampai pengguna menekan submit.

evidence.title: Pertanyaan baru: setelah submit
evidence.observation: Continue diklik. Kartu menyisakan pertanyaan, jawaban Ringkas menjadi pesan user, dan Tobi mengonfirmasi pilihan. Tidak ada receipt jawaban tersimpan.

evidence.title: Pertanyaan baru: setelah reload
evidence.observation: Reload aplikasi mempertahankan judul kartu beserta mention yang telah dirender dan avatar Tobi. Opsi serta aksi tidak kembali muncul.

evidence.title: DM tetap tanpa avatar di area pesan
evidence.observation: DM Tobi dibuka lewat navigasi UI. Pesan assistant, aktivitas Stopped, dan kartu pertanyaan yang sudah dijawab tidak memiliki avatar samping. Avatar identitas di header tetap tersedia.
